`fc2-col` = the 3 WDL weights reading the unit; its gradient is proportional to the unit's output, so its velocity measures how often/strongly the unit fires. `norm/decay` = norm ratio to fresh divided by the decay-only factor (1 = decay only). `v/p90` medians are over the leaky checkpoints 1k..latest.
